result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign and Zoho Sign** are the three e-signature platforms I'd shortlist.

The best choice depends on how many documents you send, whether you need legally binding signatures, and whether you want extras such as automated contracts, reminders and document templates.

If you're running a small business in Australia, I'd also prioritise Australian electronic-signature requirements, ease of use and transparent pricing.

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Very easy to use.
- Straightforward document signing and templates.
- Good for freelancers and small teams.
- Integrates with Dropbox and other business tools.
  
  Indicative starting price: US\$15/month for Essentials.
  
  [Official website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Vagas na Squadra – Squadra Digital](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IaP7Jkr2ymCV1KIs0LJHQGFaRuTPRHo-JzB2tP7wMr9jI-qHWc8Btme-HT0A_UsBIlp4XbN4SqYElo_xupzyU34mftiaJjWU23ihRn2-KDWAwWN1Pe85snMSmDHupCbEeqQGTL8ubG9Ixpdrv32hl_9Bwg9nvIryTjSjhn3u_C9qMTXuHbPCpilC1tXvDQny?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall functionality)

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Strong audit trails and document tracking.
- Templates, automated reminders and integrations.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.
  
  Indicative starting price: around US\$15/month.
  
  [Official website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Sign**

(Best budget option)

- Good value for smaller businesses.
- Document templates and signing workflows.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho products.
- Free tier for very light usage.
  
  Indicative starting price: around US\$10/user/month.
  
  [Official website](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Creates professional quotes and proposals.
- Combines document creation and e-signatures.
- Tracks when customers open and sign documents.
- Useful for sales-focused businesses.
  
  Free tier available; paid plans start around US\$19/user/month.
  
  [Official website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF workflows)

- Excellent PDF document handling.
- Signing, editing and document management.
- Good Microsoft 365 integration.
- Particularly useful if you already use Adobe Acrobat.
  
  Indicative starting price: around US\$16.99/month.
  
  [Official website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

Pricing is indicative, not a like-for-like Australian quote. Plans, billing terms, user limits and signature allowances vary. Sources: 2026 pricing comparisons. [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[serpastra.com](https://serpastra.com/blog/best-e-signature-software-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What about Australian businesses?

Two additional considerations\:

- **Legal validity\:** Australia's Electronic Transactions Act 1999 recognises electronic signatures for most Commonwealth processes, subject to requirements and exceptions. State and territory laws can also apply. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Australian data hosting\:** If you need Australian data residency, investigate local providers such as Annature and AirSign, as well as the larger international platforms. [www.starworks.com.au](https://www.starworks.com.au/best/software/e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down like this\:

| Your business needs | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and agreements | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional, established signing platform | DocuSign |
| Lowest-cost business solution | Zoho Sign |
| Client proposals and sales contracts | PandaDoc |
| Australian data residency | Annature |


**My overall pick would be Dropbox Sign** for a small business that mainly needs customers, employees or suppliers to sign documents without unnecessary complexity.

I'd choose DocuSign if you expect more complex workflows or higher document volumes.

## A question that would help me recommend the right one

What type of small business are you running?

For example, consulting, construction, property, professional services, retail or something else?

I can then narrow this down to the best two or three options, including Australian pricing, and recommend the one that offers the best value.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.

search_results.description: This TechRadar guide reviews the best eSign software solutions available in 2026, explaining how electronic signatures replace printing, signing, and scanning paper documents. SignNow is selected as the best option for businesses because of its intuitive document workflows, collaboration tools, tracking, and unlimited users on paid plans, though additional fees may apply after 100 invitations annually. Adobe Acrobat Sign is recommended for general users, offering powerful signing, branding, bulk sending, tracking, and Microsoft Power Automate integration. PandaDoc is best for creating polished documents, while SignRequest and SignWell emphasize beginner-friendly simplicity. Adobe Fill & Sign is the leading free option for filling and signing PDFs. DocuSign stands out for reports, reminders, and audit trails, and Dropbox Sign is recommended for cloud-storage integration. Sign.Plus provides basic functionality, while Apple Preview is a convenient Mac-based personal tool. The guide advises choosing based on users, workflow complexity, customization, reporting, budget, integrations, and internet requirements. Products were tested for setup, signature methods, form creation, usability, pricing, performance, and collaboration features.
